outcome: Help retailers reduce expiry, waste and unnecessary markdown while preserving availability, quality, food safety, and truthful sustainability reporting.
overview: Fresh categories lose margin twice: once to markdown taken too late, and again to product disposed of at expiry. This solution forecasts shelf-life risk at batch level from stock, batch, waste and demand data, then compares transfer, markdown and donation options against food-safety and price rules before a store manager approves the action. Sustainability figures are calculated from an approved, documented methodology and reconciled to inventory records, so nothing published is a guess. An 8–12 week category or store pilot measures waste and expiry reduction, sell-through and markdown contribution against a control, with food-quality sign-off on every rule the engine may apply.

benefits.text: Reduce selected waste and expiry write-off by a target 10–20% on the pilot categories
benefits.source: Redington Retail catalogue; consistent with published research on the return on food-waste reduction in retail
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Target range to validate against a control group on the customer’s own batch and waste records — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Improve sell-through and markdown contribution by acting earlier at a shallower discount
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on batch and expiry data accuracy and on store execution of the approved action within the shelf-life window

benefits.text: Produce auditable sustainability figures from a documented, approved methodology rather than estimates
benefits.source: Reference design — methodology-bound calculation reconciled to inventory and waste records
benefits.limits: Figures are only as sound as the emissions factors and methodology the customer approves; no environmental claim is made without them

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); stock, batch and waste data remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No batch, lot or expiry-date capture in stock records
notFor.why: Shelf-life risk is a batch property; without it the engine can only guess which units are close to expiry

notFor.situation: No documented food-safety and quality rules with a named approver
notFor.why: The engine may only propose actions that safety policy already permits; encoding informal practice would put unsafe sale one bug away

notFor.situation: No approved emissions or waste methodology to calculate against
notFor.why: Sustainability figures published without a stated method are a greenwashing risk, not a benefit

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns food-safety policy, pricing policy, sustainability methodology and every approved action · Duration: 8–12 weeks PoV; further 16–26 weeks to enterprise scale
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, forecasting data scientist, integration engineer; customer fresh-category owner, store operations lead, food-quality and safety reviewer, sustainability reporting lead, finance reviewer · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery, batch-data validation and waste and markdown baseline
2) Shelf-life data layer build and demand model configuration
3) Food-safety and price rule encoding with quality sign-off
4) Manager approval workflow and price-publication reconciliation testing
5) Controlled category or store pilot against a matched control
6) Benefit review, methodology audit and handover
deliverables: Batch and expiry records reconcile with physical stock at the agreed accuracy threshold
Every encoded food-safety and price rule demonstrated to block a non-compliant action
Operational UAT completed with store managers on the approval workflow
Measured waste reduction and margin recovery confirmed against the control group
Sustainability calculations traced to the approved methodology and confirmed by finance
effort: 8–12 weeks PoV; further 16–26 weeks to enterprise scale
